about.heading: About
about.body: I'm an Electrical Engineering student at the Federal University of Paraná (UFPR), with a technical background in Information Technology from TECPUC. I work as a research scholar at LACTEC (Laboratory of Analysis and Technological Science), on the CFG team, developing machine learning solutions for electrical and photovoltaic systems, from soiling detection to energy demand forecasting.

newsRadio.name: News Radio
newsRadio.hook: An automated pipeline that turns each day's economy and geopolitics headlines into a two-voice podcast episode — collected, analysed, narrated and published without a human in the loop.
highlights: 221 tests, running with no GPU, no API key and no network
Dependency injection at every external boundary, so a stranger can clone and run the full pipeline over fixtures in one command
Cost engineered, not hoped for: R$27/month measured from real runs, only one metered API call in the system

academicSearch.name: academic-search
academicSearch.hook: Search four academic databases at once, collapse the duplicates they return, and rank what's left by semantic similarity, recency, source authority and citation count — with retracted papers flagged automatically.
highlights: Cross-provider deduplication on normalized DOIs, with title fallback
Weighted ranking with sentence-transformers embeddings and a graceful keyword fallback
Retraction flagging against the Retraction Watch dataset, matched in O(1)

prosumer.name: prosumer
prosumer.hook: A Python library for day-ahead forecasting of PV generation and household consumption, the basis of my undergraduate thesis: from meter data to a complete, honest analysis.
highlights: Every default decided by a benchmark of 57 models on real plants and houses, with a pilot and a gate before anything entered the library
Re-does the benchmark's forecasts exactly, checked model by model
Never picks "the best model" for you: the output is the median of the forecasts, scored against a fair reference, at several resolutions

loom.name: Loom
loom.hook: A cross-domain recommender (anime, manga, books, music, movies and TV) that runs as a local desktop app, with no server and no cloud.
highlights: ~84,000 works from ten sources, reconciled across sources and calibrated onto one popularity scale
Two models served by the API: text embeddings and item-item collaborative filtering over 25M ratings
Recommends in a domain you have never rated, from your taste in another; 778 tests, ruff- and mypy-clean

bullets: Worked on the accumulator (high-voltage battery pack) of the electric competition car.
Client prospecting and negotiation of the junior enterprise's electrical engineering projects.
Develop machine learning models for photovoltaic monitoring and electrical demand forecasting, contributing to 6 INPI-registered software programs and 3 journal articles.
Work across the full pipeline, from weather and sensor data processing to deployable soiling-detection and load-forecasting models for residential and utility-scale systems.
Contribute to a research project developing renewable generation and energy storage solutions for irrigated agriculture, aiming to cut costs and carbon emissions in rural power systems.
Part of a multi-institution team coordinated by Bruno Knevitz Hammerschmitt, alongside researchers from LACTEC.
